column3: Pairs يوم with النار in a parallel punitive scene, though without compelled conveyance.
A contrary fire-use scene; the channel link is only a secondary branch resonance.
Exact يَدُعُّ recurrence; V12 f01 preserves a prior coercive act alongside the focus's imposed movement.
Adds bodily punishment in نار جهنم, but not the movement into it.
The immediate antecedent removes any دافع, framing the ensuing thrust as unpreventable.
Leaders direct others إلى النار and the day of reckoning, a close directional parallel with different agency.
The immediate sequel identifies the النار and retains the denial that surrounds the forced arrival.
Establishes lasting residence in نار جهنم, adding destination-state rather than conveyance.
Its fire consequence has a secondary channel resonance, but supplies no forced-motion detail.
Adds enduring نار جهنم as a consequence, without the focus's forceful route.
The immediate sequel preserves the challengers' disputed perception of the scene.
Another enduring نار جهنم consequence; redundant with earlier destination-state cards.
The immediate continuation commands entry and fixes endurance as the next stage after the thrust.
A prior يَدْعَوْنَ summons and refusal form a contrast with later non-refusable direction.
A secondary channel parallel of warding hostile pressure, not a localized reading of the ayah.
Generic lasting-fire consequence, already well covered.
Secondary channel evidence concerns permitted resistance to oppression, not the focus's destination.
Supplies only a يوم marker for the broader eschatological frame.
Continues the refuge/repulsion channel parallel without a fire-route scene.
Its يَدَّعُونَ setting adds no clear route, pressure, or fire relation.
Secondary channel evidence for protection against betrayal, remote from the focus scene.
A summons that can be turned away from provides a contrary agency pattern.
Secondary channel resonance adds a blazing-fire setting, not conveyance.
Calling إلى الخير is an opposite-direction summons, with little direct value.
Its repelling action is only a secondary channel parallel to pressure and counteraction.
Adds a fixed يوم but no fire or compelled movement.
The channel route ends in النار after diversion, a parallel destination with distinct movement.
Repeats the limited يوم frame already supplied by 15:38.
Secondary fire-channel evidence gives entry into the fire, but no forced conveyance.
A divergent route and temporary use end among أصحاب النار; less direct than prior route cards.
Adds entry into جهنم as a settled endpoint, without the thrust.
Calling إلى الله is an opposite-direction pattern, not the punitive movement.
Secondary channel evidence adds exposure to hot fire, not the approach to it.
دعاء here supplies no relevant coercion, destination, or fire scene.
Patience may echo the following verse, but the linked surety channels do not clarify the thrust.
A يوم summons toward a dreadful matter closely parallels imposed direction, while preserving a different destination.
No دافع for the disbelievers reinforces unavoidability, but repeats 52:8's point.
Explicitly drives the criminals إلى جهنم, a close parallel of compelled collective conveyance.
The cry for destruction adds a post-punishment response rather than the movement itself.
Gathering enemies إلى النار on the day adds ordered collective movement toward the same destination.
Dragging in the fire on faces is a close embodied parallel of degrading compulsion.
This دعوا claim has no clear connection to the fire-route scene.
Collapse with its subject into نار جهنم gives an involuntary fall, but through another image.
A contrary fire state; it marks fire's non-punitive use rather than supporting the focus route.
Gathering on faces إلى جهنم closely parallels compelled, humiliating transport.
A closed fire condition adds little after the direct conveyance cards.
Those already in النار call for relief, adding an interior aftermath.
Enduring punishment without death or relief is a redundant destination-state detail.
Being cast into a constricted place adds forced placement and the ensuing cry.
A hot-fire designation alone adds little beyond prior fire descriptions.
The heat comparison concerns refusal in this life, not conveyance to the fire.
Defeat followed by collective gathering إلى جهنم gives a directional endpoint without the thrust verb.
Its دعوة contrast does not clarify coercion into the fire.
A kindled divine fire adds fire character, but no movement or day scene.
Competing calls toward النار and toward the garden provide an alternate-direction summons.
Invocation and fear of punishment do not add a transport or entry scene.
On the day, faces are turned in the fire; it adds an embodied punitive state after arrival.
A leader brings his people to the fire on the day, preserving collective directed movement and distinct agency.
Presentation to the fire and an entry command add a staged punitive arrival.
Jahannam follows a battlefield act, an indirect and nonparallel route.
Calls upon others and return to God do not clarify the focus scene.
The disbelievers are driven إلى جهنم in groups, the nearest collective-conveyance parallel.
Collective gathering إلى جهنم adds the destination but not the focus's forceful manner.
Gathering on faces to جهنم adds humiliation and altered condition, though later than stronger parallels.
Submission on that day may frame lost agency, but lacks fire or movement.
Today's abandonment and the fire abode repeat consequence without transport.
The promised day supplies only a broad temporal frame.
Presentation to the fire on the day adds a confrontational stage, not movement into it.
Fire and prior denial recur, but this is redundant with 52:14 and lacks conveyance.
Entry into Jahannam follows misconduct, a generic endpoint already covered.
Another presentation-to-fire scene, redundant with 46:34 and less about movement.
Fire as abode and lack of helpers offer a generic aftermath.
War-fire imagery is a contrary fire use, not the eschatological route.
A day gathering culminating in the fire as abode adds collective judgment, without the forced route.
The channel's fire consequence is secondary and lacks the focus's movement.
Being kept from the fire is a contrary outcome, not evidence for the thrust.
A limited-fire claim adds a denial posture relevant to the focus's surrounding challenge.
Being cast into the fire contrasts with safety and adds passive punitive placement.
Repeats the limited-fire claim already represented by 3:24.
The explicit أضطره إلى عذاب النار closely preserves compulsion and destination.
The believers' light and garden scene does not add to the fire-route reading.
Light and darkness imagery has no clear relation to the compelled-fire scene.
The darkness/light contrast adds no route, pressure, or punishment detail.
Its legal and temporal material has no clear relation to the focus.
Entry into a flaming fire is a generic punishment state already covered.
Displaying Jahannam to disbelievers on the day adds pre-entry confrontation.
A day summons that cannot be answered adds constrained response, without the fire destination.
Arrival in groups on the day preserves the collective aspect of the secondary reading, but lacks fire or coercion.
Jahannam as ambush adds a destination image, not the thrust or arrival.
This invocation scene does not clarify the focus's punitive movement.
The quaking day is only a broad eschatological setting.
Woe to deniers on that day reinforces the denial frame, but adds no route.
Fire defined by fuel adds only a generic fire property.
A final station to the Lord gives broad destination language, not the fire route.
The garden's approach is a contrary outcome with no focused movement parallel.
This earthly assembly and success claim do not illuminate the focus.
Its consequence statement has no clear fire, day-route, or coercion relation.
Resurrection evidence supplies only a remote basis for the day scene.
Support and victory language does not add to the punitive conveyance.
Mocking signs and humiliating punishment loosely retain denial and consequence, but not the focus scene.
The command to gather the wrongdoers supplies the collective compulsory stage before the route to الجحيم.
فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ is a close imperative parallel for directed conveyance to the fire.
خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ gives an exceptionally close image of violent forced transport.
Chains at the neck establish an explicit restraint setting for the ensuing compelled movement.
The chained are dragged and then placed in النار, closely paralleling degrading compulsion and destination.
The command أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ directly adds authoritative casting into the same destination.
خُذُوهُ begins an ordered seizure sequence that closely supports the focus's imposed agency.
The command to expose him to الجحيم supplies the next forced punitive stage.
Insertion into a chain extends the restraint imagery after the fire command.
The day, جهنم, prior denial, and command to enter form a close continuation parallel to 52:13-16.
The entry command through جهنم's gates completes the driven-groups scene of 39:71.
Gathering and bringing people around جهنم in a kneeling state closely adds compelled collective presentation.
On that day the criminals are bound in fetters, supplying a restraint parallel without the fire destination.
An imperative entry into جهنم's gates adds authoritative arrival, but not the thrust.
Repeats the gate-entry command already supplied more directly by 39:72 and 16:29.
Its repeated imperative toward what was denied parallels directed movement and the denial frame, while leaving the destination implicit here.
لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ gives passive casting into a fire designation, a compact parallel of imposed placement.
Being cast into it adds a passive entry scene and the fire's reception, without the day or route.
Repeated return to the fire against attempted exit develops ongoing compulsion after arrival.
Its repeated restoration to punishment parallels forced return, though it concerns post-entry movement.
وَارِدُهَا may bear a passage/arrival relation to the fire; retain it as a parallel without resolving that reading.
أَنتُمْ لَهَا وَٰرِدُونَ places the addressed group in a direct relation of arrival to جهنم, without the focus's forceful manner.
نُصْلِهِۦ جَهَنَّمَ adds externally imposed entry into the same destination.
سَوْفَ نُصْلِيهِمْ نَارًۭا supplies imposed exposure to fire, but no transport image.
سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ adds a direct punitive placement formula with a different fire name.
لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ supplies entry into the fire but is otherwise a generic outcome.
جَعَلْنَا لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَىٰهَا adds a punitive destination state, without compelled movement.
نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ with unending suffering adds a consequence state already covered by stronger cards.
جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا repeats fire entry without a day, command, or conveyance detail.
The fire's تَدْعُوا relation to those who turn away preserves a contrary but relevant summons pattern.
The kindling of الجحيم provides only environmental preparation for the punishment scene.
A blazing-fire outcome is generic and adds no compelled direction.
The threatened seizure by the forelock preserves forceful handling but has no stated fire destination.
